question: Setting a mapping or list onto an existing collection: merge entry-wise or replace the block

routes.reasoning_given: Never rewrite what the user did not ask to change
routes.route: Merge entry-wise (keep, change, append, delete); unchanged entries keep their bytes and comments

routes.reasoning_given: Those comments described the old entries
